nodes.description: Public string state variable holding the base metadata URI, set by setMetaURI and read by baseTokenURI.
Mapping(address=>uint256) storing the reserved tokenId whitelisted for each address.
Mapping(address=>string) storing the custom image hash/URI associated with a whitelisted address.
Private counter used by the ERC721Tradable2 base to derive token ids.
Public address of the OpenSea ProxyRegistry used to whitelist proxy operators in isApprovedForAll.
Mapping(address=>uint256) of meta-transaction nonces consumed by executeMetaTransaction.
Public entry point allowing any caller to mint the token reserved for _msgSender().
onlyOwner function that updates the metaURI state variable and validates non-empty input.
onlyOwner function that whitelists many addresses with reserved tokenIds and images in a loop.
onlyOwner function that removes a whitelisted address and clears its reserved tokenId and image.
Internal virtual view returning attrTokenids[_to] and reverting if the address is not whitelisted.
Internal view returning attrImgs[ownerOf(_tokenId)] for the token owner.
View function returning metaURI as the base URI used for token metadata.
Overridden ERC721 tokenURI that base64-encodes JSON combining name, metaURI and _getImg.
Payable meta-transaction entry point that verifies a signature, increments the user nonce and calls back into the contract with attacker-supplied calldata.
Overridden sender resolution delegating to ContextMixin.msgSender, which may decode the real sender from msg.data.
Overridden approval check that whitelists the OpenSea proxy registry operator.
onlyOwner mint helper that mints the token reserved for the target address.
Attacker-controlled caller address, used for ownership checks, whitelisting and as meta-transaction relayer.
Block timestamp, not referenced directly in the analyzed logic.
Transaction origin, not referenced directly in the analyzed logic.
Low-level address(this).call(...) inside executeMetaTransaction that executes attacker-influenced calldata before state effects settle.
ecrecover-based signature verification in verify(), which trusts sigV/sigR/sigS supplied by the caller.
Inline assembly in ContextMixin.msgSender reading the trailing 20 bytes of msg.data to derive the effective sender.
calldata string parameter of setMetaURI holding the new metadata URI.
calldata address[] parameter of addWhite with the addresses to whitelist.
calldata uint256[] parameter of addWhite with the reserved token ids.
calldata string[] parameter of addWhite with the per-address image references.
address parameter of removeWhite identifying the whitelist entry to delete.
address parameter passed to _getTokenId to look up the reserved token id.
address parameter of executeMetaTransaction for whom the meta-transaction is executed.
bytes parameter of executeMetaTransaction carrying the inner call payload.
Loop counter used inside addWhite to iterate over the whitelist arrays.
uint256 token id parameter of _getImg used to resolve the owner's image.

edges.reason: The _metaURI calldata parameter is validated and assigned into the metaURI state variable.
setMetaURI writes the caller-supplied value into the metaURI state variable.
setMetaURI is gated by onlyOwner, which compares owner() against the untrusted msg.sender.
addrs array is iterated and its entries drive whitelist writes in addWhite.
tokenIds array values are written into attrTokenids in addWhite.
imgs array values are written into attrImgs in addWhite.
addWhite assigns attrTokenids[addrs[i]] for each whitelisted address.
addWhite assigns attrImgs[addrs[i]] for each whitelisted address.
Loop index i controls the bounds of the whitelist update loop.
addWhite is restricted by onlyOwner keyed on msg.sender equality with the owner.
The addr parameter selects the entry reset in removeWhite.
removeWhite zeroes attrTokenids[addr].
removeWhite clears attrImgs[addr] to an empty string.
removeWhite is gated by onlyOwner comparing against msg.sender.
mintByUser resolves the minter through the overridden _msgSender().
ContextMixin.msgSender returns payable(msg.sender) when not a self-call.
_msgSender falls through to inline assembly when msg.sender equals the contract.
Assembly block derives a sender address from the trailing bytes of msg.data.
mintByUser calls _mintTo which in turn invokes _getTokenId for the sender.
The _to address is used as the lookup key in _getTokenId.
_getTokenId reads attrTokenids[_to] and reverts when zero.
tokenURI calls baseTokenURI to build the metadata JSON.
baseTokenURI returns the metaURI state variable.
tokenURI calls _getImg to embed the owner image into the metadata.
_getImg reads attrImgs[ownerOf(_tokenId)].
The _tokenId parameter drives the ownerOf lookup inside _getImg.
isApprovedForAll reads proxyRegistryAddress to query the proxy registry.
executeMetaTransaction performs a low-level call to itself with user-controlled calldata.
The self-call re-enters contract logic where msg.sender is the attacker-controlled caller.
executeMetaTransaction relies on ecrecover-based verify to authorize the signer.
ecrecover result is compared to the supplied userAddress to establish identity.
userAddress selects which nonce is consumed and is bound into the signed message.
functionSignature is appended to userAddress and executed in the self-call.
executeMetaTransaction increments nonces[userAddress] to prevent replay.
The relayer msg.sender is emitted in the MetaTransactionExecuted event.
mintTo resolves the token id through _getTokenId before minting.
mintTo is protected by onlyOwner checking msg.sender against the stored owner.

normalization_plan.reason: The _metaURI calldata parameter exists only to feed the setMetaURI state write and has no independent semantics.
The addrs array parameter is only consumed by the addWhite whitelist loop.
The tokenIds array parameter is only consumed by the addWhite whitelist assignments.
The imgs array parameter is only consumed by the addWhite image assignments.
The addr parameter is only used to index the whitelist state cleared by removeWhite.
The _to parameter is the sole lookup key of _getTokenId and should be folded into that function.
userAddress is only meaningful inside executeMetaTransaction for nonce and signature binding.
functionSignature is only meaningful as the executed payload of executeMetaTransaction.
The loop counter i is a transient local of addWhite's iteration and carries no standalone meaning.
The _tokenId parameter only serves the ownerOf lookup inside _getImg.
